environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. ALB is configured with standard HTTPS listener (port 443) forwarding to target group on port 8080. No mutual TLS configured. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The ECS task has network access to internal VPC services including the metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254) and internal microservices. No egress filtering applied to the task ENI.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM certificate, no client cert verification
